questions.question: Which campaign was launched by the Women and Child Development Ministry to eliminate child marriages in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Women and Child Development Ministry launched the "Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat" campaign to eliminate child marriages.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The campaign focuses on high-burden states where child marriage rates are significantly above the national average.
 
• Approximately 200,000 child marriages were prevented in the past year as part of this initiative.
 
• The goal is to reduce child marriage rates to below 5% by 2029.
 
• The campaign prioritizes seven states: West Bengal, Bihar, Jharkhand, Rajasthan, Tripura, Assam, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• Nearly 300 districts across India report child marriage rates above the national average.
 
• Child marriage impacts one in five girls in India before they reach the legal age of 18.
 
• The initiative aims to engage all states and Union Territories to implement targeted action plans.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Child Marriage in India:**__

 __
 
• Approximately one in five girls in India is married before the age of 18.
 
• Child marriage limits educational, health, and economic opportunities for girls.
 
 
 
• **Legal Measures:**__
 
 
• The Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, prohibits child marriages in India.
 
• Various government schemes such as Beti Bachao Beti Padhao and Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana aim to uplift and protect girl children.

questions.question: What is the maximum coverage provided under the "Cashless Treatment" scheme launched by Union Minister Nitin Gadkari for road accident victims?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1.5 lakh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Union Minister Nitin Gadkari launched the "Cashless Treatment" scheme to cover road accident treatment costs up to ₹1.5 lakh for seven days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The "Cashless Treatment" scheme provides up to ₹1.5 lakh for accident victims' treatment if the police are informed within 24 hours.
 
• The scheme also offers ₹2 lakh ex-gratia payment for families of victims in hit-and-run cases.
 
• Road safety remains a top priority for the government with additional measures for safer transport of school children.
 
• The scheme aims to address the growing number of road accidents and reduce the financial burden on victims' families.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Ex-gratia Payment__

 __
 
• A payment made to the families of victims in exceptional cases such as hit-and-run accidents, to provide financial assistance in their time of need.
 
 
 
• Road Safety Measures__
 
 
• The government is implementing various measures, including helmet enforcement and safe transport systems for school children, to improve road safety across the country.

questions.question: The Union Cabinet has approved the PM Vidyalaxmi scheme to assist which group of students in securing loans for higher education?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Middle-class students**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Union Cabinet approved the PM Vidyalaxmi scheme aimed at providing education loans to middle-class students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The scheme will cover up to one lakh students annually, offering a 3% interest subvention for students with family incomes up to Rs 8 lakh on loans up to Rs 10 lakh, and full interest subvention for incomes up to Rs 4.5 lakh.**
 
• Eligible students can receive collateral-free and guarantor-free loans.
 
• Loan applications will be processed through the **PM-Vidyalaxmi portal.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM Vidyalaxmi Scheme__

 __
 
• Aims to provide financial assistance to students pursuing higher education.
 
• Designed to eliminate financial barriers for meritorious students.
 
 
 
• Interest Subvention__
 
 
• Government provides interest rate reductions to eligible students.
 
• Encourages families with lower incomes to seek education loans.

questions.question: Which Indian government initiative recently crossed 10 lakh rooftop solar installations?

options.text: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana has surpassed 10 lakh rooftop solar installations, marking a major milestone in India's renewable energy sector.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Launched on February 13, 2024, by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, the scheme aims to make solar energy accessible to Indian households.**
 
• **It has received 47.3 lakh applications, with ₹4,770 crore disbursed in subsidies to 6.13 lakh beneficiaries.**
 
• **States like Gujarat, Uttar Pradesh, and Kerala are leading in the adoption of rooftop solar under this initiative.**
 
• **The government targets reaching 1 crore solar-powered homes by 2026-27.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM Kusum Yojana__

 __
 
• Launched in 2019 to promote solar energy use in agriculture.
 
• Targets installation of solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants.
 
 
 
• National Solar Mission__
 __
 
• Launched in 2010 under the National Action Plan on Climate Change.
 
• Aims to establish India as a global solar energy leader.
 
 
 
• UJALA Scheme__
 
 
• Launched in 2015 to distribute LED bulbs and promote energy efficiency.
 
• Led to significant energy savings and reduction in carbon emissions.

questions.question: The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on which date?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**22nd January 2015.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Over four crore Sukanya Samriddhi accounts have been opened across India under the scheme.**
 
• The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22nd January 2015 as part of the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign.
 
• It allows parents to open an account for girls at post offices or designated commercial bank branches.
 
• 22nd January 2025 marks ten years since the scheme's launch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana was launched on 22nd January 2015 to promote savings for the education and marriage of girl children.**
 
• It is a small savings scheme under the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao initiative aimed at empowering the girl child.
 
• Parents or legal guardians can open accounts for girls below the age of 10 years.
 
• The scheme provides tax benefits under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act and offers attractive interest rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)__

 __
 
• The scheme allows deposits of up to ₹1.5 lakh annually with attractive interest rates and maturity benefits.
 
• The account matures after 21 years or upon the marriage of the girl, whichever is earlier.
 
• The scheme is instrumental in supporting the education and future of girls across the country.
 
 
 
• Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao Campaign__
 
 
• Launched in 2015, this initiative aims to address declining child sex ratios and promote the welfare of girls.
 
• It focuses on education, health, and financial independence of the girl child.

questions.question: Which bill was introduced in Lok Sabha in 2025 to establish a university focused on the cooperative sector?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tribhuvan Sahkari University Bill.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The **Tribhuvan Sahkari University Bill 2025** was introduced in **Lok Sabha** to establish the **Tribhuvan Sahkari University**, recognizing it as an **institution of national importance**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The bill seeks to convert the Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA) into Tribhuvan Sahkari University.**
 
• The university will provide technical and management education in the cooperative sector.
 
• It aims to promote cooperative research and development, aligning with the vision of ‘Sahkar Se Samriddhi’.
 
• The bill was introduced by Union Minister of State for Cooperation, Krishan Pal Gurjar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA)**__:

 __
 
• Founded in **1979** in **Gujarat**.
 
• Known for promoting **cooperative and rural development studies**.
 
 
 
• **‘Sahkar Se Samriddhi’ Vision**__:
 __
 
• A government initiative to **boost cooperative movements in India**.
 
• Aims at **strengthening cooperative institutions** through education, training, and research.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Cooperation**__:
 
 
• Established in **2021**, led by **Amit Shah** as the first Cabinet Minister.
 
• Focuses on **strengthening the cooperative sector** through policies and institutional support.

questions.question: What amount has the Government of India allocated for setting up the Green Hydrogen Mission Centre?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs 100 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Government of India has allocated Rs 100 crore for establishing Centres of Excellence (CoE) under the National Green Hydrogen Mission Research and Development (R&D) Scheme.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Proposals for setting up these CoEs have been invited by the **Ministry of New and Renewable Energy on November 4, 2024.**
 
• The goal is to promote** innovation, sustainability, and energy self-reliance through the production, storage, and utilization of green hydrogen.**
 
• These Centres will focus on research, skill development, and knowledge dissemination while fostering collaboration between **government, industry, and academia.**
 
• The CoEs will play a crucial role in accelerating India's transition to a low-carbon economy and boosting green hydrogen technologies.
 
• Public and private entities, including research institutes and universities, are encouraged to submit proposals for the R&D scheme.
 
• Launched on January 4, 2023, the **National Green Hydrogen Mission has a target outlay of Rs 19,744 crore by FY 2029-30,** aiming to make India self-reliant in clean energy and reduce carbon dioxide emissions.
 
• The mission will also help reduce India's dependence on fossil fuel imports, positioning the country as a global leader in green hydrogen technology.

questions.question: Which state launched ‘Buffer Mein Safar Yojana’ to boost ecotourism?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Uttar Pradesh launches ‘Buffer Mein Safar Yojana’ to boost ecotourism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**‘Buffer Mein Safar Yojana’** is a new **ecotourism initiative** launched by the **Uttar Pradesh Forest and Wildlife Department**.

 
 
• 
 
The main goal is to promote **sustainable and eco-friendly tourism** in the **buffer zones** of **tiger reserves**.

 
 
• 
 
The scheme aims to **empower local communities** by offering them **training and employment opportunities** in the tourism sector.

 
 
• 
 
It also seeks to strengthen **wildlife conservation efforts** by encouraging **community-led protection of biodiversity**.

 
 
• 
 
The initiative is part of Uttar Pradesh’s effort to become a **leading ecotourism destination** in India.

 
 
• 
 
The scheme is being implemented in **major tiger reserve buffer zones** such as **Dudhwa**, **Pilibhit**, and **Lakhimpur Kheri**.

 
 
• 
 
**Sohagibarwa** and **Katarniaghat wildlife sanctuaries** are also part of the scheme.

 
 
• 
 
**Semrai Lake**, an important stopover for migratory birds, is being developed as part of the **ecotourism circuit**.

 
 
• 
 
A **modern information centre** has been set up at the **Dudhwa Tiger Reserve** to enhance visitor engagement.

 
 
• 
 
The scheme integrates **tourism, conservation**, and **local employment** as a model for balancing **ecological sustainability** with **economic growth**.

questions.question: According to the Jal Jeevan Mission, what is the percentage target for rural households to receive tap water by 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**100%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Jal Jeevan Mission aims to provide **100% functional household tap connections (FHTCs) to all rural households by 2024**.
 
• Launched by the Ministry of Jal Shakti in **August 2019**, the mission focuses on water supply infrastructure in rural areas.
 
• Under this initiative, **55 liters of water per person per day** is targeted to be supplied to every household.
 
• It emphasizes **community participation** and involves local bodies like Gram Panchayats in the implementation process.
 
• The scheme aligns with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goal-6, which ensures access to clean water and sanitation for all.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jal Jeevan Mission Key Components:**

 
 
• Ensures piped water supply to households in rural areas.
 
• Promotes decentralized service delivery models, including rainwater harvesting and greywater management.
 
• Focuses on water quality monitoring and testing to prevent contamination.
 
 
 
• **Community Participation:**
 
 
• Village Water and Sanitation Committees (VWSCs) play a crucial role in planning and executing projects.
 
• Capacity-building programs are conducted for local communities to ensure efficient water resource management.
 
 
 
• **Financial Allocation:**
 
 
• The scheme operates on a cost-sharing model between the central and state governments.
 
• Significant funds have been allocated to states based on their requirement and progress.
 
 
 
• **Challenges Addressed:**
 
 
• Addresses issues like water scarcity, contamination, and poor infrastructure.
 
• Encourages sustainable practices to ensure long-term water security.
